source_school: Harvard College Dean of Students Office Staff
title: Executive Assistant and Program Coordinator
bio: I have worked for almost 20 years in a variety of different roles at Harvard College. This includes the Office of Admissions and Financial Aid and the Office of Special Concentrations. I have also been a first-year academic adviser for the past 6 years. In my free time, I enjoy reading, baking, traveling to new places, and spending time with my family and friends. I am also the proud cat mom of a two year old kitty named Zavi. He was adopted during the pandemic and is still trying to make me feel guilty every time I leave the house to come to work.
